items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-09-01
items.q: The interviewee only confirms the interviewer's statement that Pat Sullivan was a trumpet player who played no jazz. The interviewee does not claim to have met, played with, or collaborated with Pat Sullivan.

ctx.x: No, but his was an arranged band. Johnny Ronica is a very fine arranger. And he was playing at Lentz when I auditioned for him. I'm trying to think of who was leaving. Pat Sullivan was a trumpet player. And Pat played no jazz. He played no jazz?
